name: @tradrl/adapter-alternative-data
description: Alternative-data adapter: declared source descriptor, documented public observation schemas (sentiment scores, on-chain metrics, economic and satellite series), mapping tables with the declared window->release availability policy (an observation covering window W becomes available at its declared release instant, never mid-window), vendor-licensed entitlement tiers, declarative rate quotas and the normalized session over an injected transport port (spec/ADAPTERS.md, Work Order T038). Zero runtime dependencies; provider semantics live here and nowhere else (L2/L13).
